name: Banh beo
summary: Bánh bèo is the afternoon cake on the city portal’s 24 November 2022 page, made from bột lọc with a shrimp or pork filling and a heavy hand of herbs. Báo Nghệ An, 28 April 2023, names it among the fixed kitchens on Đào Tấn.
origin: Vinh. The 24 November 2022 city page describes the cake. The 28 April 2023 Báo Nghệ An page puts it on Đào Tấn.
howToEat: Order it in the afternoon on the city page, or at the fixed kitchens on Đào Tấn. The city page says bột lọc, shrimp or pork, and a lot of herbs. It does not print a price. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Đường Đào Tấn, from cửa Hữu to cửa Tả, on the 27 April 2023 Báo Nghệ An account. Fixed kitchens on that account were allowed 24 hours. A 2026 night list was not opened.
seoTitle: Banh beo in Vinh — shrimp or pork cake
seoDescription: Bánh bèo in Vinh is a bột lọc cake with shrimp or pork and herbs. Báo Nghệ An lists it on Đào Tấn. A price is Check on arrival.
